name: KristaRutz/grow-a-plant-ConsoleGame
description: A console application to grow your own plant. Start with a Plant, and add resources allowing the plant to grow. For example, Water(), Feed(), and GiveSunshine(). Each round, the plant may grow a certain amount (or die) based on the actions the user takes.  For an additional challenge, every few turns, special events cause trouble for your plant. For instance, you could encounter a Storm() or AphidAttack().
